Title: MainLayout Layout Component
Summary: Primary layout component providing the sidebar navigation and main content area.
Content:
## MainLayout.razor **Path:** `Components/Layout/MainLayout.razor` **Type:** Layout component (`@inherits LayoutComponentBase`) ### Purpose Provides the primary page structure: a sidebar with navigation and a main content area. ### Structure ```razor
About
@Body
An unhandled error has occurred. Reload 🗙
``` ### Sections | Section | Description | |---------|-------------| | `.sidebar` | Contains the `NavMenu` component. | | `.top-row` | Header bar with an external "About" link to ASP.NET Core docs. | | `article.content` | Renders `@Body` — the routed page content. | | `#blazor-error-ui` | Hidden by default; displayed when an unhandled exception occurs in the Blazor circuit. | ### CSS Scoped styles in `MainLayout.razor.css` control the sidebar width, top-row height, and responsive behavior. ### Usage Set as the default layout in `Routes.razor`: ```razor ``` Individual pages can override with `@layout OtherLayout`. ### Notes - The `data-nosnippet` attribute on `#blazor-error-ui` prevents search engines from indexing error text. - The error UI is styled by Blazor framework CSS; the dismiss button (🗙) hides it client-side.
